invisbleman3.text: Still a fresh name on the board, and already fighting like a fixture: among the very best tracked on nearly every count, quick on the trigger, and unmoved when the opposition gets serious. The lifetime board agrees with the matchups, which is rare for a young account. Early days, but the opening chapters read like someone who arrived knowing the game.

igorrrrrr.text: IgOrRrRrR chooses the moment, then stands firm: sitting with the very best tracked, steady on the trigger, and holding their ground when the opposition gets serious. The lifetime board is split down the middle: the kill-death line agrees with the matchups, while the IvI line sits near the very bottom. The edge holds against the toughest third too, which is the mark of results that hold up under any lens.

isaiinztr.text: iSaiinZTR is a blur: matchup rating and activity both among the elite, with bravery to boot and a tempo that never cools. The accuracy sits at the very top, and the lifetime IvI ranks among the very best too. A player who turns each fight into a footrace and usually wins it.

inspijeoles.text: InSpijeoles plays the complete game: among the hardest chargers in the game, sitting at the very top, and dauntless whatever the fight demands. The lifetime IvI sits at the very top too, which makes the two boards agree. Against the hardest third, the edge dips a little: the lone blemish on an otherwise strong card.

iballistic8.text: iballistic8 keeps the tempo high: top shelf across the matchups, with pace near the top and results to match. Headshots run below average, yet the scoreboard stays strong regardless. The public board shortchanges this one: the career IvI line runs well below the matchup rating.

iamthealphaandomega.text: IAmTheAlphaAndOmega plays the long game beautifully: the rating, the pace, the courage, and the resistance all sit in the top ranks, with accuracy to match. The matchup kill-death mark and the lifetime board both sit above average, short of the summit, and consistency holds above average too. Read this one as an outline drawn from an older, smaller opponent sample, not a finished portrait.

ihatenanites.text: IHateNanites is a fresh account with a sharp opening: barely two weeks in, and already tempo near the very top, resistance to match. Bravery sits near the very bottom, yet the matchup kill-death mark lands near the top and the aim is the very best tracked. Early days, but the opening pages already carry real weight — a selective newcomer with elite hands.

incrediblystatuesquesublimegirl.text: IncrediblyStatuesqueSublimeGirl sets a relentless tempo: kills coming quicker than almost anyone tracked, bravery that climbs with the opposition, and resistance near the very top. Aim runs precise, a strong share of shots land as headshots, and the matchup mark sits well above average. Consistency is the one mid-pack wrinkle on an otherwise top-shelf record, and the lifetime board lines up with the matchups.

iviagicns.text: IVIagicNS is a tale of two cards: matchup rating just under the very top, resistance higher yet, and a matchup kill-death mark that matches — but consistency near the very bottom. Against the strongest third, the edge collapses; the pace is middling and headshots are scarce. The lifetime board lands mid-pack, so the matchups flatter them a little — brilliant in the right fight, fragile in the hardest ones.

inimicusnc.text: InimicusNC has been at this since 2012, and the game still sits top-shelf: every adjusted line sits near the very top, their matchup kill-death figure close behind. The aim sits above average, headshots run mid-pack, and the lifetime board sits there too. The edge fades below average when the opposition is at its strongest, the lone soft spot in a long career.

inimicusvs.text: InimicusVS has played a top-shelf game since 2013: the matchup rating, the activity, and the resistance all crowd the very top, a matchup kill-death figure in step. The aim sits mid-pack, while the lifetime board lands there too, well below the matchups. Treat this one as a rough sketch rather than a finished portrait: the duels behind it come from an older, smaller pool.

idkhowididthat.text: idkHowIdidThat wins by volume and nerve: a matchup kill-death mark at the very top, resistance among the best tracked, and accuracy up near the top. The headshot share lands near the bottom, and the lifetime IvI lands mid-pack, so the matchups rate them clear of the lifetime board by a mile. A player whose results keep outrunning the explanations.

idgaffff.text: idgaffff plays at full throttle and never looks back: the tempo and the fight against stronger enemies both rank near the very top, with kills arriving faster than almost anyone tracked and the matchup grade running just as high. The aim is precise, headshots land near the top, and the lifetime numbers sit in the same elite bracket. A relentless, high-volume force.

inimicustr.text: InimicusTR has played since 2012 and still sets the pace: rating, activity, and bravery all in the top ranks; resistance and kill-death marks close behind. Aim is sharp, headshots middling, and the results hold up as the opposition improves. Lifetime numbers put them above average, a notch below the matchups — a long career, still near the peak.

idf41i.text: IDF41I plays like a rising tide: rating and activity near the top, bravery and resistance right there with them, and the kill pace keeps up. The matchup kill-death mark lands a notch above the middle, and the aim and headshot shares sit in that same upper range. The lifetime board rates this one a touch below the matchups.

ilostmymercy.text: ILostMyMercy arrived days ago and already plays like a fixture: activity, bravery, and resistance all near the top, with a matchup kill-death mark near the very top. Accuracy sits near the top, the headshot share too, and the lifetime numbers back the matchups. Early read on a young account, but the first pages already carry weight.

ivoxi.text: IVoxI builds on patience: resistance near the top and a matchup kill-death mark near the very top, with the lifetime kill-death board best of all tracked. Bravery sits mid-pack and the consistency mark dips below average, so the edge thins when the opposition hardens. Still, the aim stays steady and headshots land well above average, enough to keep the record elite.

icantaimwithoutaimassist.text: iCantAimWithoutAimAssist plays a relentless, high-volume game: activity and bravery near the very top, with pace and output both up among the highest tracked. Accuracy and headshots both sit near the top, with the lifetime board also rating them near the top. Consistency dips below average, the one wrinkle on a strong card.

ignasio.text: Since 2013, Ignasio has been the model of a long career done right: upper tier in the matchups, with defences that hold against fast opposition and a duel kill-death figure near the top. The tempo runs above the middle, the aim ordinary, and the lifetime board sits a step behind the matchups. Consistency against the hardest third lands mid-pack, the only average line on the card.

igrockai.text: Igrockai wins the fights that count and shrugs at the rest: top-shelf on the matchup board, with a lifetime kill-death ratio near the top and a one-on-one kill-death tally behind it. The accuracy is near the top, the headshot share below average, and the lifetime IvI lands mid-pack — the matchups carry the story here. When the fights get hardest, the edge thins a little.

ilrambocatil.text: IlRamboCatIl brings a storm every time: a top-shelf rating, a blazing tempo, and a duel ledger that stays strong against the hardest opposition. The lifetime board sits a step below the matchups, and the grip loosens slightly when the fighting gets hardest. Still, this is a fighter who shapes the battle around their own pace.

ibulleti.text: ibulleti keeps it simple and keeps it working: matchup rating near the summit, resistance that absorbs the best fire going, and bravery that holds as fights get nastier. The aim sits comfortably above average, and the lifetime board sits above average too. Consistency rests mid-pack — a calm, rounded fighter with no drama attached.

iiiimlgpotato.text: iiiiMLGPotato turns up ready every time: matchup rating in the upper echelon, bravery that keeps pace as the opposition gets tougher, and resistance that shrugs off stronger fire. The aim clears the average comfortably, and the career IvI reads lower than the matchups suggest — the duels are the real measure here. A steady, sharp regular with no obvious hole.

iteemo.text: iTeemo has been around since 2015, and the matchups still rate them top-bracket: resistance that stands tall against stronger fire, bravery that keeps pace, and a head-to-head kill-death tally well above average. The lifetime board sits lower than the duels suggest. Take this one as a sketch — the duels behind it come from an older, thinner pool.

ins0n1tytr.text: Ins0n1tyTR has fought since 2014 with a game that has no weak corner: a matchup rating sitting in the upper tier, with resistance that holds, and every line on the card sitting above the middle. No drama either way when the opposition peaks — the edge holds its shape. The lifetime board and the matchups paint the same picture: a veteran who keeps showing up and keeps delivering.
